reference: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original enemy character reference for a hand-inked cel-shaded tactical RPG. Single full-body rangy adult man, sun-darkened face, stubble, black hair tied back under a knotted rag, rust-red neck scarf pulled down from face, narrowed eyes and crooked grin. Ragged sleeveless dusty rust-brown vest, rope-wrapped wrists, patched gray-brown trousers with uneven torn hems, rope belt, cloth-wrapped shins and worn sandals. Carries one knotted wooden club in his right hand, resting on his right shoulder, left hand relaxed beside hip. Adult realistic animation proportions, lean ex-quarry-worker build. Three-quarter view slightly from above, facing screen-right, head to feet fully visible with generous margin. Clean uniform dark-brown #1b1410 ink outlines; exactly two flat color tones per material and subtle thin rim highlight. Enemy rust palette base #8a4b3c shadow #4d241b highlight #b8705c, skin natural flat tones. Plain flat warm parchment #f4e9d8 background. No scenery, cast shadow, text, labels, borders, logos, skin markings, gradients, photographic texture or known character likeness. Hands anatomically correct with four fingers and one thumb; trace shoulder/elbow/wrist to each hand, thumb opposite curling fingers around the club, natural grip. Portrait composition 1024x1536.
sheet: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent animation sprite sheet. Input image is CHARACTER IDENTITY REFERENCE ONLY. Create this same original rangy rust-clothed bandit in EXACTLY NINE full-body poses, arranged as a strict regular THREE COLUMN by THREE ROW grid. Preferred canvas 1536x2304, each of the nine cells 512x768. Genuine alpha transparency throughout background, not an opaque checkerboard. Each complete figure, including club, must stay inside its own cell, with at least 60px clear gutters on every edge. Uniform character scale across all nine poses; crouched and kneeling poses must become shorter, never enlarged. Same face, black tied-back hair, rust head-rag and neck scarf, ragged sleeveless rust vest, rope belt and wrist wraps, patched gray-brown trousers, shin wraps, sandals, single knotted wooden club. Adult proportions, three-quarter top-down view slightly above, ALL nine figures face SCREEN-RIGHT. Readable game art: CLEAN uniform dark-brown #1b1410 outlines, flat cel fills using ONLY base and one shadow per material; remove reference's scratches/hatching/texture. No soft shading, gradients or fine decorative detail. Enemy rust #8a4b3c, shadow #4d241b, highlight #b8705c. Keep hands anatomically coherent: four fingers and opposing thumb, wrists trace to their own arms, natural club grip, never extra fingers or fused wrists. Row 1 left to right: (1) idle A in compact ready stance, club held low in right hand, left hand loose at waist; (2) idle B same stance and planted feet with only chest lifted slightly for breathing; (3) walking contact A, near leg planted forward, far leg back, club held low and steady, opposite arm gently swinging. Row 2 left to right: (4) walking contact B with opposite leg forward and opposite arm position, identical scale; (5) attack windup, weight on rear foot, BOTH HANDS gripping club drawn behind right shoulder, compact silhouette; (6) attack release, firm forward planted step to screen-right with both hands driving club diagonally down to screen-right, still entirely inside cell. Row 3 left to right: (7) attack recovery, club lowered and weight returning to centered stance; (8) hit recoil, shoulders lean back away from screen-right, one foot lifted, retain club with right hand; (9) defeated on one knee, head bowed, left hand rests on raised knee, right hand loosely holds club tip against invisible ground. No wounds or blood. SAME character every cell. NO labels, numbers, letters, grid lines, borders, scenery, background remnants, dust, motion trails, effects, ground shadows or cast shadows. Keep all nine isolated with wide completely transparent gutters so the sheet can be split safely.
